reference_route: Accepted American Empire Scene 01 identity/environment heroes and motion benchmark are active references; this is not a no-reference production.
continuity_source: Scene 02 terminal narrative state S2-10 plus accepted Scene 01 motion/picture language; using Scene 02 terminal continuity for planning does not auto-promote any still-unapproved Scene 02 picture candidate.
visual_language: Same cinematic comic-book/graphic-novel world: bold inked value separation, restrained halftone/print texture, slate and pale gray-blue environment, cream Paris stone, muted cyan technology, warm amber practical light, deep charcoal shadows, rain-slick reflections, no saturated cyberpunk neon.

full_media_policy.rule: Use the full approved/promoted Scene 03 source pool. The eight heroes are continuity/composition anchors and the Assembly05 29-segment map is the current edit, not the maximum coverage library.
full_media_policy.exclusion: Genuinely rejected/unpromoted drift media stays excluded. Legacy filename text is not lifecycle authority when ASSET_MANIFEST records explicit promotion.

primary_hero_assets.description: Immediate continuation from S2-10 in the same apartment geography: Claire secures/carries the already-approved essential, phone retained, storm/city transition visible behind. Camera locked. Hero is an anchor, not exclusive coverage.

Claire at the apartment door opening into the same building hallway; motivated dark charcoal outer layer may be introduced on-screen over established wardrobe; corridor practical/access indicators begin synchronized change. Hero is an anchor, not exclusive coverage.

Long-axis corridor with Claire moving outward and no more than one or two anonymous residents cautiously appearing; multiple access indicators/doors change state in ordered sequence; no panic crowd. Hero is an anchor, not exclusive coverage.

Locked elevator interior with Claire and ordinary control panel; building selects/overrides toward lobby/ground route through diegetic indicator behavior. Interface remains practical, not holographic. Hero is an anchor, not exclusive coverage.

Building lobby with exterior rain through glass and dry interior; exit/access hardware changes state in a coordinated mechanically plausible sequence; prepared transition motif must inherit Scene 02 proof language. Hero is an anchor, not exclusive coverage.

Claire foreground at the building threshold facing a rain-dark Paris street; traffic and transit systems reorganize in a controlled sequence; deep semantic foreground/midground/background planes and restrained parallax. Hero is an anchor, not exclusive coverage.

Claire profile/over-shoulder toward ordinary municipal/transit display and distant civic/security activity; same prepared transition status appears across independent systems; controlled authority transfer, no invasion spectacle. Hero is an anchor, not exclusive coverage.

Long street composition with Claire moving with purpose into Paris, phone in hand, coordinated city behavior continuing behind; walking requires bounded generated continuation or a motivated cut between stable states. Hero is an anchor, not exclusive coverage.

alternate_state_policy.allowed: Existing approved/promoted Scene 03 stills, clean generated support imagery, GIFs, matched-angle companions and source-derived states may all be used as motivated coverage when continuity/QC passes.

generated_pairs.states: door closed -> door physically open into identical hallway topology
start/destination only if generated continuation is unavailable
generated_pairs.reason: motivated cut fallback, not fake motion

alternate_state_policy.forbidden: Do not create alternate framings merely to manufacture camera movement or A/B oscillation.

generated_continuation_policy.required_for: Only real articulated actions not adequately covered by approved existing media, such as securing/shouldering an essential, opening a door while moving through it, or sustained walking.
forbidden_mutations: new hallway topology within a chained action

animated_insert_policy.rule: Animated inserts are diegetic scene events and must remain physically registered to their housings/surfaces.

reuse_policy.scene01_scene02_canon: Use accepted/authorized continuity material as reference or traceable source-derived coverage only. Preserve identity, environment topology, palette and motion language.
reuse_policy.scene03_existing_media: Exhaust the approved/promoted Scene 03 source pool before requesting replacement generation. Preserve valid non-hero coverage and proved loop assets.
reuse_policy.new_generation: No wholesale hero/library regeneration. New generation is limited to specific missing articulated continuation/action coverage authorized by SCRIPT.json and the zero-drift continuation contract.

fx_policy.authority: current repository main through CANONICAL_EFFECT_REGISTRY -> fx_v2/registry.json
fx_policy.depth: real semantic multiplane 2.5D or approved restrained pseudo-depth where the registry and shot contract permit
fx_policy.weather: coherent storm; rain exterior/window/doorway exposure only
fx_policy.camera: locked or near-locked; motivated bounded move only
fx_policy.automatic_gate: Only current-main effects with gate_status=approved execute automatically. proof_required/conditional/unavailable effects fail closed unless their exact gate is satisfied.
fx_policy.project_local: Existing Scene 03 micro-motion and matched-angle project-local FX remain usable because their project-local gate/QC passed.

next_candidate: Assembly06 full-media + current-main approved FX pass
